dedupe_keys.name: nz topo50 infrastructure layers road railway powerline pipeline bridge tunnel and dam features at 1 50 000 linz

description: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) publishes the layers of its Topo50 topographic map series as separate vector datasets on the LINZ Data Service. The Topo50 series maps the New Zealand mainland, the Chatham Islands and offshore islands at 1:50,000. Coverage: among the infrastructure layers are NZ Road Centrelines (153,518 line features, with road name, state highway number, lane count, way count, status and surface), NZ Railway Centrelines (567 features, with status, track type, railway use and vehicle type), NZ Powerline Centrelines (7,223 features, with support type), NZ Pipeline Centrelines (385 features, with pipe use and visibility), NZ Bridge Centrelines (16,365 features, with construction type, status and use), and tunnel, dam, embankment, wharf, runway, airport, reservoir, tower, mast, pylon, tank and building layers. The road layer was last published on 29 June 2026 and the railway layer on 23 April 2026. Format and access: each layer is downloadable and served through the LINZ Data Service (Koordinates platform) with web services and an API; a data dictionary on docs.topo.linz.govt.nz defines the attributes. Free. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Caveats: the layers are cartographic at 1:50,000 scale, so positions are generalised and attributes are sparse (the powerline layer has only the support type); counts were read from the API on the day of access. Simulation uses: national road, rail, power line and pipeline networks for New Zealand hazard exposure, network flow and interdependency studies. Related records: NZ Building Outlines (data-linz-nz-building-outlines) is the detailed LINZ building layer.
